name: OLD VOICE ATLAS 001
purpose: Link broad historical-recording seams now; let later use cases perform targeted retrieval and custody.

legal_clock.rule: Published U.S. sound recordings first published before 1926 are public domain under the Classics Protection and Access Act / Music Modernization Act schedule.
legal_clock.caution: Public-domain status of the underlying recording does not automatically grant unrestricted reuse of every archive's modern transfer; obey item-level digitization terms.
